_comment: Session-level analysis prompts (DATA, not code) — #65 Phase 1.
Each kind is one whole-transcript prompt; the judge returns a JSON
object the Studio renders verbatim. Placeholders: {facts} {project}
{transcript}. Literal braces in the templates are doubled because
str.format fills them. required_keys is what the parser insists on;
everything else is coerced or dropped. Bump version when a template
changes so stored results can be told apart.
session-v3: the judge is told the harness stamp and the project's
ACTUAL steering/configuration files, and may name only those — it no
longer assumes CLAUDE.md (a project on AGENTS.md gets AGENTS.md).
